_about: Transport tiers, lowest first. A run starts with the first tier, and the player buys each later tier in order for its price. max_remoteness: the highest market remoteness that the tier reaches (see markets.json); it cannot go down along the list. A new link uses the tier the player has as its vehicle. A link keeps its vehicle until the player pays vehicle_upgrade_cost to move it onto the tier the player has now. plural_name is the name of more than one vehicle, such as Trucks. transit_time_ms and shipment_cost are per shipment. The first tier has no price and no vehicle_upgrade_cost. automatic_transport_cost is the price of automatic transport for one link. PLACEHOLDER values until playtests set them.
